gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-national-park: National Park is a sans-serif body of rounded letters with a clearly open side, drawn with a pen that never shifts pressure. Shantell Sans brings the swagger; National Park keeps the lines readable.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-niramit: Niramit gives its curves a gaping, open look and only slight stroke modulation. And Shantell Sans, drawn with one fixed nib width, does the shouting while Niramit does the explaining.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps every small counter unclogged. Shantell Sans, whose horizontals are no thinner than its verticals, supplies the personality, and that gap in temperament is the whole appeal of the pairing.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noto-sans-manich: Strokes like pulled solder: that's Shantell Sans up top. Below it, Noto Sans Manichaean keeps its e crossbars open-mouthed, so whole paragraphs of text move along without any snagging.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noto-sans-new-ta: Shantell Sans draws a wire-like monoline skeleton with a wide, tin-can mouth, giving the heading a distinctly expressive look. Noto Sans New Tai Lue's cupped, unclenched rounds make a sans-serif foil.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noto-sans-nko: Spaghetti-like strokes, all one width, carry Shantell Sans. Noto Sans NKo, with c openings you can see through, lets text run on smoothly, line after line, without drawing attention to itself.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noto-sans-shavia: Shantell Sans looks laser-cut from a sheet, one cutting width throughout, loud and expressive. And what really sets it apart is Noto Sans Shavian's loose, rope-like curves beneath that heading.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ojuju: Approachable is the right word for Ojuju, whose wide s curves and lightly flexed stroke contrast sit under Shantell Sans. Paragraphs set in it glide along without any fuss.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-overpass: Overpass never mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes in a word. Shantell Sans, drawn with one fixed nib width, supplies the personality, while Overpass makes sure its e never turns into a blot.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-palanquin: A cable bent into letter shapes: that is Shantell Sans. Beneath it, Palanquin's wide, unclosed curves are the real standout quality, staying open against all that wiry, bent-metal spirit.
